character.name: Thirst Goblin MG base v3
character.prompt: A small wiry goblin no taller than a standard goblin fighter, bright green skin with his bare face and big pointed ears visible under a dented steel pot helmet worn low, wearing a heavy dark leather apron over baggy trousers and a bulky square ammunition backpack, a short belt of linked machine gun cartridges arcing from the backpack over one shoulder down into a rusted belt-fed light machine gun held low across the body with the muzzle angled down, bipod folded flat along the barrel, low top-down perspective, single color black outline.

states.note: Generated at 48x48 (pro mode, style anchor 1337cfb6 = shipped Goblin), padded to 64x64 with feet on y=47. South-east rotation carries a 2-pixel glint repair (white muzzle pixels recolored to gun metal) - the raw glint seeded muzzle-flash artifacts in every animation of that facing. Animations carry point repairs of animator-invented muzzle flash (white pixels recolored/erased); standing_idle and standing_idle_walk south-east are re-rolls seeded from the repaired frame. One-shot sets are sealed to start on the idle rotation.
